Senior Data Engineer (f/m/x) – Remote within EU

Kelpie Analytics GmbH | Berlin or remote (CET ±2h) | €75,000–€92,000 + VSOP

Who we are
Kelpie helps 300+ mid-sized retailers forecast demand. Our platform ingests ~2 TB of POS and inventory data per day.

Your mission
- Design, build and own batch and streaming pipelines
- Model our warehouse in dbt and keep data quality high
- Work with data scientists to productionise feature pipelines

What you bring
- 5+ years in data engineering or a similar role
- Strong Python and SQL
- Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or Flink
- Production experience with Airflow (or Dagster/Prefect)
- dbt and a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake or BigQuery)
- Fluent English; German is not required
- BSc in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Preferred
- Kafka
- Terraform and AWS
- Experience with data contracts or data mesh is a plus

What we offer
30 vacation days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club, home office equipment, two team off-sites per year.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Kelpie Analytics is committed to equal opportunities regardless of gender, origin, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.
